name: active_lounge_requests
definition:
SELECT co.id AS request_id,
    co.lounge_id,
    co.booking_id,
    co.user_id,
    'canteen_order'::text AS request_type,
    co.status,
    co.is_attended,
    co.is_read,
    co.created_at,
    to_jsonb(co.*) AS request_data
   FROM canteen_orders co
  WHERE (co.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND co.is_attended IS FALSE
UNION ALL
 SELECT sc.id AS request_id,
    sc.lounge_id,
    sc.booking_id,
    sc.user_id,
    'service_call'::text AS request_type,
    sc.status,
    sc.is_attended,
    sc.is_read,
    sc.created_at,
    to_jsonb(sc.*) AS request_data
   FROM service_calls sc
  WHERE (sc.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND sc.is_attended IS FALSE
UNION ALL
 SELECT cr.id AS request_id,
    cr.lounge_id,
    cr.booking_id,
    cr.user_id,
    'client_request'::text AS request_type,
    cr.status,
    cr.is_attended,
    cr.is_read,
    cr.created_at,
    to_jsonb(cr.*) AS request_data
   FROM client_requests cr
  WHERE (cr.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND cr.is_attended IS FALSE
UNION ALL
 SELECT bi.id AS request_id,
    b.lounge_id,
    bi.booking_id,
    b.user_id,
    'booking_item'::text AS request_type,
    bi.status,
    bi.is_attended,
    bi.is_read,
    bi.created_at,
    to_jsonb(bi.*) || jsonb_build_object('lounge_id', b.lounge_id, 'user_id', b.user_id) AS request_data
   FROM booking_items bi
     JOIN bookings b ON b.id = bi.booking_id
  WHERE (bi.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text])) AND bi.is_attended IS FALSE;

name: geometry_columns
definition:
SELECT current_database()::character varying(256) AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geometry_column,
    COALESCE(postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod), sn.ndims, 2) AS coord_dimension,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod), 0), sr.srid, 0) AS srid,
    replace(replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod)), 'GEOMETRY'::text), st.type, 'GEOMETRY'::text), 'ZM'::text, ''::text), 'Z'::text, ''::text)::character varying(30) AS type
   FROM pg_class c
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND NOT a.attisdropped
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid
     JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            replace(split_part(s.consrc, ''''::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text) AS type
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%geometrytype(% = %'::text) st ON st.connamespace = n.oid AND st.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (st.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text)::integer AS ndims
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%ndims(% = %'::text) sn ON sn.connamespace = n.oid AND sn.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sn.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            replace(replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text), '('::text, ''::text)::integer AS srid
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%srid(% = %'::text) sr ON sr.connamespace = n.oid AND sr.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sr.conkey))
  WHERE (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT c.relname = 'raster_columns'::name AND t.typname = 'geometry'::name AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);

name: slot_waitlist
definition:
SELECT id,
    user_id,
    lounge_id,
    room_id,
    requested_date AS date,
    preferred_start_time AS slot_time,
    status,
    created_at
   FROM booking_waitlist;

name: canteen_upsell_conversion_v
definition:
SELECT r.lounge_id,
    r.id AS rule_id,
    r.trigger_type,
    count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['shown'::text, 'impression'::text])) AS impressions,
    count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'conversion'::text])) AS conversions,
        CASE
            WHEN count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['shown'::text, 'impression'::text])) = 0 THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'conversion'::text]))::numeric / count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['shown'::text, 'impression'::text]))::numeric, 2)
        END AS conversion_rate_percent,
    COALESCE(sum(e.revenue_generated) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'conversion'::text])), 0::numeric) AS revenue_generated
   FROM upsell_rules r
     LEFT JOIN canteen_upsell_events e ON e.rule_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.lounge_id, r.id, r.trigger_type;

name: canteen_low_stock_alerts_v
definition:
SELECT lounge_id,
    id AS extra_id,
    COALESCE(name_ar, name) AS name_ar,
    COALESCE(name_en, name) AS name_en,
    category,
    COALESCE(stock_quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity,
    COALESCE(min_stock_alert, 5) AS min_stock_threshold
   FROM extras e
  WHERE COALESCE(is_active, true) IS TRUE AND COALESCE(track_stock, false) IS TRUE AND COALESCE(stock_quantity, 0) <= COALESCE(min_stock_alert, 5);

name: geography_columns
definition:
SELECT current_database() AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geography_column,
    postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod) AS coord_dimension,
    postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod) AS srid,
    postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod) AS type
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n
  WHERE t.typname = 'geography'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);
